title: Antidote
summary: Drink or throw to neutralize poisons.

fields.Drink: Bonus Action. Neutralizes poisons on the drinker.
fields.Throw: Action. Throw up to 60 ft. Neutralizes poisons within 3 ft of impact.
fields.Base value: 13 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 mechanics and pinned item and related rule sources.
